'''Yurii Grigorievich Reshetnyak''' ({{langx|ru|Ю́рий Григо́рьевич Решетня́к}}, 26 September 1929 – 17 December 2021) was a Soviet and Russian mathematician and academician.<ref>[http://www.math.nsc.ru/LBRT/u2/nauka/reshetny.html Решетняк Юрий Григорьевич]</ref>

He worked in geometry and the theory of functions of a real variable. He was known for his work in the [[Reshetnyak gluing theorem]]. Reshetnyak received the 2000 [[Lobachevsky Prize]] from the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>[https://www.ras.ru/about/awards/awdlist.aspx?awdid=62 Lobachecvsky Prize], [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. Accessed January 13, 2014</ref>

Reshetnyak died on 17 December 2021, at the age of 92.<ref>[https://ngs.ru/text/science/2021/12/18/70325639/ В Новосибирске скончался известный математик Юрий Решетняк] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>
